_about: Public-domain Percy Dearmer, Anglican priest and liturgist, for the Word Hoard: The Parson's Handbook, Loyalty to the Prayer Book, The Ornaments of the Ministers, Everyman's History of the English Church, Body and Soul, Reunion and Rome, The Communion of Saints, The Arts of the Church, Fifty Pictures of Gothic Altars, and his handbooks to the cathedral churches of Oxford and Wells. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 129 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

Richards, 1899)
